title: Causal learning and target licensing are orthogonal

objects.meaning: RACH-style normalized causal learning score in the witness family.
Whether every resulting evidence class is target-constant in the exact witness.

results.claim: For every causal information level k, two experiments can have the same I(S;Q)=k while one never licenses the target and the other always licenses it.
Maximal normalized RACH-style causal learning can coexist with zero deterministic target licensing.
Zero RACH-style causal learning can coexist with complete deterministic target licensing.
Equal-cost causal-information and target-licensing objectives can rank the same pair of experiments in opposite order.

claim_ceiling: Noiseless deterministic evidence classes only in TU-2A-C.
Does not replace CED failure/risk theory.
Does not claim general active-learning or information-theory novelty.
Does not equate mutual information with empirical scientific value.
open_extension: Characterize necessary/sufficient conditions under which RACH causal-learning ranking and CED reliability-qualified target-resolution ranking coincide.
